title: Algebraization of a coherent system on a fixed proper closed subscheme
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $f:X\to S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $n\geq0$ put $S_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $X_n=X\times_S S_n$ [def-pc-base-change], and let $j_n:X_n\to X$ and $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Pullback is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]; coherent modules are as in [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ for the canonical natural comparison induced by $i_nj_{n+1}=j_n$. Let $F_n$ be coherent $\mathcal O_{X_n}$-modules with isomorphisms $\varphi_n:i_n^*F_{n+1}\cong F_n$. Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion with $Z\to S$ proper. Suppose its ideal $\mathcal J_Z$ annihilates every $j_{n,*}F_n$: for every $n$, open $V$, $a\in\mathcal J_Z(V)$ and $t\in(j_{n,*}F_n)(V)$, $at=0$. Then there is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $G$ with support proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] and isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong F_n$ such that $\varphi_n\circ i_n^*\psi_{n+1}=\psi_n\circ c_{n,G}$ for every $n$.

source.place: Theorem 088E (theorem-grothendieck-existence), first paragraph, reducing a system supported on a proper closed subscheme to Proposition 088C (proposition-existence-proper), with Lemma 087T and Remark 088F

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-systems-dictionary], the pushed terms form a coherent formal module for $I\mathcal O_X$; its terms are killed by the ideal of $j$. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-coherent-equivalence] (2), lift it to a formal module on $Z$ for the extended ideal, together with the completion comparison.

Apply [prop-weil-pbc-grothendieck-existence-proper] on $Z$ to obtain a coherent algebraization. Closed-immersion coherent equivalence and its natural completion comparison give a coherent pushforward $G$ on $X$ whose completion is isomorphic to the original formal module.

The support formula for coherent closed pushforward identifies $\operatorname{Supp}G$ with the image of the support of the coherent module on $Z$. That support is closed by [lem-weil-pbc-module-support-proper-over-base] (1). It is a closed subset of the proper $Z$, hence its image is proper over $S$ by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties].

The isomorphism correspondence in [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-systems-dictionary] gives the $\psi_n$ from the completion isomorphism. Its natural comparison and transition equations give exactly compatibility with $\varphi_n$ and $c_n$.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 088E and Remark 088F; the dictionary and natural comparison details are expanded as in the parent proof.
